g.text: RMX A0.1 / BYPASS PERMISSION LOGIC / DRAFT - native KiCad/ERC and full carrier validation pending
U22/U23 clear both U24 stages on faults. Two rising heartbeat edges are needed; the intervening falling edge starts watchdog monitoring.
B1 external 5V/3.3V, midrail health and one stereo dry relay; original watchdog/stage logic retained.
TPS3435AFACADDFRQ1: 10.1 nF CWD gives 49.995 ms nominal; 20% timer tolerance applies. This is not a 50 ms maximum fault-to-dry guarantee.
